today_news.title: Claude can now generate animated explainer videos and live data dashboards from text prompts
today_news.summary: Anthropic launched two new beta features for Claude. Dashboards turns data sources like BigQuery and Snowflake into live dashboards from text prompts. Motion generates animated explainer videos from text and images. Docs, Slides, and Design now work across all plans, including free accounts.

today_news.title: OpenAI's safety crisis keeps getting worse and the company keeps making it worse
today_news.summary: OpenAI fired three safety researchers who helped investigate the Hugging Face hack. In an open letter, they warn that the firings are scaring remaining staff and eroding safety culture. OpenAI claims they violated policies but won't say how.

today_news.title: Being mean to Claude can now get your account suspended under Anthropic's new TOS
today_news.summary: Anthropic's updated usage policy bans sustained abuse of Claude and tightens restrictions on propaganda, drone weaponization, and surveillance. The abuse rule builds on an approach that already lets models end some conversations and treats Claude as an entity that may deserve protection.
